rules.statement: The trial judge must identify the land to be partitioned first, and if the parties are not in agreement about the identity of the corpus and boundaries, it is the duty of the court to identify the correct land.
rules.supporting_quote: If the parties are not in agreement about the identity of the corpus and boundaries it is the duty of court to identify the correct land.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 44 of the Civil Procedure Code
